name: dentosim
description: DentoSim — multi-tenant white-label SaaS for clear-aligner treatment simulations

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @dentosim/canonical build && pnpm --filter @dentosim/pipeline build && pnpm --filter @dentosim/viewer-core build && pnpm --filter @dentosim/server build && pnpm --filter @dentosim/worker build && pnpm --filter @dentosim/web build
scripts.pretest: pnpm --filter @dentosim/canonical build && pnpm --filter @dentosim/pipeline build && pnpm --filter @dentosim/viewer-core build && pnpm --filter @dentosim/server build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @dentosim/canonical test && pnpm --filter @dentosim/pipeline test && pnpm --filter @dentosim/viewer-core test && pnpm --filter @dentosim/server test
